fact: MISAU's 2022-23 national data-quality assessment visited 175 of 180 facilities across all 11 provinces and compared facility registers with what SIS-MA, the national health management information system, reported, using four reporting tiers (facility, district, province, central).
MISAU's SISMA interoperability page says SIS-MA exchanges data with the medicines logistics platform Ferramenta Central (CMAM) and with the Ministry of Justice's SIRCEV death-certificate system.

Malaria Consortium's IATI record says upSCALE, a mobile electronic community health information system used by community health workers, is being institutionalised into the Ministry of Health and scaled to all 10 provinces under a US$4.6m grant from January 2025.

DHIS2 says the Ministry of Health officially adopted DHIS2 in 2015 as the national health management information system, known as SISMA, the integrated platform for routine data of all health programmes, covering 161 districts.
